title: Concurrent Suspense Resource Cache with Deduplication
concept: Resource Keying, Concurrent Request Deduplication & Invalidation
problemStatement: Implement `createSuspenseCache()` with `get(key, fetcher)` that deduplicates in-flight promises across concurrent suspended components, caches resolved results, and supports selective `invalidate(key)`.
interviewTrap: Without request deduplication in a shared Suspense cache, three child components suspending on the same user ID will fire three redundant network requests simultaneously.

testCases.name: Deduplicates multiple calls for identical key to single fetch invocation
testCases.testFn: const cache = createSuspenseCache(); let fetches = 0; const fetcher = () => { fetches++; return Promise.resolve(42); }; cache.get('u1', fetcher); cache.get('u1', fetcher); return fetches;

testCases.name: Invalidation causes subsequent call to fetch fresh data
testCases.testFn: const cache = createSuspenseCache(); let fetches = 0; const fetcher = () => { fetches++; return Promise.resolve(42); }; cache.get('u1', fetcher); cache.invalidate('u1'); cache.get('u1', fetcher); return fetches;

testCases.name: Suspends correctly on pending record
testCases.testFn: const cache = createSuspenseCache(); const record = cache.get('u2', () => new Promise(() => {})); try { record.read(); return false; } catch (p) { return p instanceof Promise; }

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: When a component suspends, it throws a Promise up the Fiber tree. React catches the promise, pauses the render phase for that branch, renders the nearest Suspense fallback, and resumes when the promise resolves.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Render Phase: Fiber node evaluation and hooks linked-list dispatch for Resource Keying, Concurrent Request Deduplication & Invalidation.
2. Reconciliation: Double buffering and fiber diffing mechanics.
3. Commit Phase: Synchronous/passive effect execution and DOM mutation.
